headline: National Grid petition for underground utility work on Wheeler Street, plus a multi-family housing special permit on Day Court #4.
summary: The committee will review a National Grid petition to install underground conduit near Wheeler Street and Shore Hill Road, and continue review of a special permit application for a four-to-six unit apartment conversion at Day Court #4. A zoning amendment on lot size requirements in the RC-40 district is also listed as a matter to be continued.
items: PP#2026-005: National Grid petition to install underground conduit from pole 511 to property line of 115 Wheeler Street, Gloucester, MA

SCP2026-007: Seaside Legal Solutions, P.C. (Owner, Billiken Investments LLC) application for Day Court #4, Map #219, Lot #155, to convert building to four-to-six dwelling units under GZO Sec. 2.3.1(7) and Sec. 3.2.2 fn (e), in the R20 district (cont. from July 22, 2026) (cont. to October 7, 2026)

CC#2026-012 (Memhard): Proposed amendment to GZO Sec. 3.2.1 to change minimum lot area per dwelling unit in the RC-40 (Coastal Residential) district from 20,000 sf to 40,000 sf (cont. from July 8, 2026) (cont. to October 21, 2026)
location: 1st Floor Conference Room, City Hall, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester MA 01930
